about: Fictional ferry-dispatch runbook. Original pages for Desk.

pages.title: Weather hold
pages.body: A departure holds when the harbor wind is at or above 28 knots.

pages.title: Gangway
pages.body: The gangway closes 8 minutes before the published departure.

pages.title: Noon crew
pages.body: The noon boat needs 4 crew: one master, one mate, and two deckhands.

pages.title: Fuel call
pages.body: A fuel call is due when the port tank reads under 35 percent.

pages.title: Radio
pages.body: Dispatch uses VHF channel 12. Emergency calls use channel 16.

pages.title: Long slip
pages.body: Slip B is the only slip that fits a boat longer than 40 meters.

pages.title: Tide
pages.body: A sailing is canceled when the tide height is under 1.4 meters.

pages.title: Full boat
pages.body: A full boat is 186 passengers. Standby boarding starts at 170 passengers.

pages.title: Delay text
pages.body: The first delay text goes out at 15 minutes late, then again every 20 minutes.

pages.title: Missing child
pages.body: A missing child page uses the code amber-deck and locks the gangway.

pages.title: Refunds
pages.body: A weather cancellation refunds the ticket in full. A crew cancellation refunds the ticket and 10 dollars.

pages.title: Bikes
pages.body: Bikes are capped at 22 per sailing. The first 6 spots are reserved for island residents.

pages.title: Night cabin
pages.body: After 21:00 the cafe is closed and the cabin lights stay at half.

pages.title: Deck ice
pages.body: If deck ice is reported, speed is capped at 9 knots until the mate clears it.
